tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
The recorded steps show a complete workflow for creating a GitLab issue, starting from authentication through to issue form submission. The agent had to:
1. Navigate to GitLab and handle authentication (login failed, so registration was required)
2. Register a new account with unique credentials
3. Navigate to the target project (a11yproject/a11yproject.com)
4. Access the issues section and click "New issue"
5. Fill the issue creation form with available fields

Task Definition:
Create a tool that creates a new issue in a specified GitLab project with various fields including title, description, assignee, milestone, labels, due date, and confidential setting.

Action Plan:
1. Navigate to GitLab and handle authentication (registration required)
2. Navigate to the target project's issues page
3. Click "New issue" button
4. Fill title field
5. Fill description field with rich text
6. Set assignee (if available)
7. Set milestone (if available)
8. Add labels (if available)
9. Set due date (if available)
10. Toggle confidential checkbox
11. Submit the issue

Variable Identification:
Based on the steps and form fields observed:
- Authentication credentials (username/email, password) - required for access
- Project path (e.g., "a11yproject/a11yproject.com") - required for navigation
- Issue title - required field
- Issue description - optional but important
- Assignee - optional (dropdown selection)
- Milestone - optional (dropdown selection)
- Labels - optional (input field)
- Due date - optional (date picker)
- Confidential - optional boolean

Step Optimization:
The recorded steps show extensive scrolling and exploration that isn't needed for the core task. We can optimize by:
1. Using direct navigation where possible
2. Using elementHash for stable element selection
3. Removing unnecessary scrolling and waiting steps
4. Focusing only on essential form interactions

Critical Issues from Previous Attempt:
1. Connection refused errors - need to use correct base URL from the session
2. Authentication is required - tool must include login/registration steps
3. Some fields (assignee, milestone, labels, due date) weren't visible in the demo but should be included as optional parameters since they're standard GitLab fields

The tool should handle the complete workflow from authentication to issue submission.
name: create_gitlab_issue
description: Creates a new issue in a GitLab project with title, description, assignee, milestone, labels, due date, and confidential settings. Handles authentication and navigation to the target project.

steps.description: Handle authentication - either login with existing credentials or register new account
steps.task: Check if already logged in. If not, register a new account with unique credentials if {register_new_account} is true, otherwise attempt to login with available credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the target project page

steps.task: Find and click on the 'Issues' link or tab to navigate to the project's issues page
Find and click the 'New issue' button to start creating a new issue

steps.description: Enter the issue title in the title field
Enter the issue description in the rich text editor

steps.task: If {assignee_username} is provided, find and select the assignee from the dropdown
If {milestone_name} is provided, find and select the milestone from the dropdown

steps.description: Add labels to the issue if specified
steps.task: If {labels} is provided, add the labels to the issue

steps.description: Set issue due date if specified
steps.task: If {due_date} is provided, set the due date for the issue

steps.description: Toggle confidential checkbox if {confidential} is true

steps.task: Find and click the 'Submit issue' button to create the issue

input_schema.name: gitlab_url
input_schema.description: Base URL of the GitLab instance (e.g., http://172.26.116.102:8080)

input_schema.name: assignee_username
input_schema.description: Username of the assignee (must be a project member)

input_schema.name: milestone_name
input_schema.description: Name of the milestone to associate with the issue

input_schema.name: labels
input_schema.description: Comma-separated list of labels to apply to the issue

input_schema.name: due_date
input_schema.description: Due date for the issue (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

input_schema.name: confidential
input_schema.description: Whether the issue should be confidential (visible only to team members)

input_schema.name: register_new_account
input_schema.description: Whether to register a new account if not logged in (default: true)
